Print the user name associated with this console.

## Synopsis

```text
whoami
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Prints the name of the console of this session.

## Examples

Name of the console this session is logged in with:

```text
whoami
```
